verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS billing platform that ships client-side Paddle.js, server SDKs, and a hosted MCP server, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out in Paddle.js, the SDKs, the MCP servers, or the dashboard. The community comments concern merchant access to customer emails, not telemetry controls, so they do not bear on this story.
